subject.title: [Bug]: sessions_yield subagent wake can compact parent branch at low context usage

question: Should OpenClaw persist a closed compaction trigger reason and require provider final-call/context snapshots before successful-turn overflow compaction on parent wake paths?
rationale: The remaining work crosses compaction policy, provider usage accounting, and persisted transcript metadata, so automation should not choose the permanent data shape or reason taxonomy alone.

options.title: Persist trigger reason and prove wake path
options.body: Add a closed compaction trigger field, ensure provider usage snapshots cannot inflate parent wake context, and require live sessions_yield/subagent proof before closing this issue.

options.title: Keep source guard only for now
options.body: Treat current contextUsage safeguards as a partial mitigation and defer schema changes until a fresh current-main repro isolates the remaining provider path.

options.title: Split metadata into follow-up
options.body: Close this issue only for spurious compaction after live proof and open a narrower issue for persisted trigger attribution.

recommendation.title: Persist trigger reason and prove wake path
recommendation.body: Add a closed compaction trigger field, ensure provider usage snapshots cannot inflate parent wake context, and require live sessions_yield/subagent proof before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The most concrete current-main provenance is the recent overflow predicate work in the central package used by session compaction.
